items.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.answer: Digital products, websites, brand identities and interactive installations — usually where design and technology need to work closely together. Budgets typically start around €30k.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: A focused website takes 6 to 10 weeks. Larger products are delivered in phases, with something usable shipped every few weeks.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside France?
items.answer: Yes. Around half of our clients are international, and our offices in Montréal, Tunis and Tokyo help us cover most time zones.

items.question: Can you join a project that is already under way?
items.answer: Absolutely. We regularly audit existing products, then plug into in-house teams for design, front-end or accessibility work.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Every project includes a 90-day warranty. After that, we offer flexible maintenance plans and ongoing product partnerships.
